svg.title: screen finds both edits in the Q8_0 GGUF
svg.desc: screen reads general.architecture qwen3, maps layers.0.self_attn.q_proj to blk.0.attn_q.weight and layers.12.mlp.down_proj to blk.12.ffn_down.weight, reverses the raw ne shapes to 2048x1024 and 1024x3072, and reports 2 kept, 0 missing and 0 reshaped with exit code 0. Values are not compared.
